family.description: Members of this family have two highly conserved cysteine residues within the DxxCxxC motif at the N-terminal. This motif is conserved in the thiol-disulfide oxidoreductase family [[cite:PUB00096851]]. This family includes At5g50100 (also known as DCC1) from Arabidopsis thaliana, a thioredoxin that modulates ROS homeostasis resulting in de novo shoot initiation and may be involved in the improvement of the capacity of plant regeneration [[cite:PUB00096851]]. Uncharacterised proteins from bacteria are also included in this family.
family.name: DCC1-like thiol-disulfide oxidoreductase
